sloka: सर्वे विशल्या विरुजः क्षणेन हरिप्रवीरा निहताश्च ये स्युः।गन्धेन तासां प्रवरौषधीनां सुप्ता निशान्तेष्विव सम्प्रबुद्धाः ।। ६.७४.७४ ।।
transliteration: sarve viśalyā virujaḥ kṣaṇena haripravīrā nihatāśca ye syuḥ।gandhena tāsāṁ pravarauṣadhīnāṁ suptā niśānteṣviva samprabuddhāḥ ।। 6.74.74 ।।

translations.english: From the beginning of the war in Lanka till the end without exception, all the Rakshasas were killed in war by the Vanara leaders then and there were thrown into the ocean by Ravana's instruction, not to have means of proof.
